stories.title: Championship roundup: West Ham stage dramatic comeback on Scott Parker’s opening night
summary: West Ham recover from 3-0 down to draw 3-3 at CardiffLeaders Middlesbrough beaten 2-0 at WrexhamScott Parker’s return to West Ham had had looked like beginning in painful fashion but instead featured a stunning comeback from 3-0 down.

The east London club’s new head coach had watched Cardiff’s Jack Moylan help himself to a first-half hat-trick, before a rousing response after the break ended with Max Kilman levelling the scores at 3-3 eight minutes from time.

Elsewhere in the Championship, leaders Middlesbrough went down 2-0 at Wrexham.Parker had been confirmed as West Ham’s head coach earlier on Wednesday, taking over from Nuno Espírito Santo, who was sacked on Tuesday.

stories.title: Billions in revenue proves Fifa right on the World Cup – but only on things it cares about
summary: The 2026 edition of the tournament brought in untold amounts of money to Gianni Infantino’s governing bodyThe total hasn’t entirely stopped rising yet, still clicking away towards a final tally.
Still, Fifa has already announced that it surpassed its own lofty revenue projections for the 2026 World Cup, bringing in $15bn, significantly more than anticipated.
While 2026’s expanded World Cup added 40 games to the schedule, the takings nevertheless went from an average of about $14.5m per match to about $48m.
